notes: v198: Countries that hate you now act on it. Hostile neighbours (relations under 25) raid your border — troops lost, relations sink, and for a year a war on them counts as self-defence (no infamy). Countries that loathe you no longer need to beat you alone: they rally friends who also dislike you and attack as a camp, gambling on a smaller edge (nuclear powers still deter most of them). Denouncing them makes all of this more likely. At most three such wars at a time, and you get an intelligence warning when one is mobilising.
